sourcePolicy.knownValues: Preserve existing non-null values. A reviewed correction may fill only an explicitly null field. Conflicting known values fail the build and require a separately reviewed reconciliation.
sourcePolicy.resourceMapping: ResourceCost for Original; ResourceCostD for D. The vector follows the registry resource IDs. A missing resource key inside a present map is zero; a missing map remains unknown.
sourcePolicy.timeMapping: BuildTime for Original; BuildTimeD for D. Retained native consumers interpret the validated integer values as base seconds.
sourcePolicy.prerequisiteMapping: ReqBuilding for Original; ReqBuildingD for D. Resolve the referenced row to its exact building type, level and rank.
sourcePolicy.constructionItemMapping: ReqItemSoc remains separate from the four ordinary resources. Item names come from the retained official language dictionaries.
sourcePolicy.powerMapping: BattlePower is shared by the retained configurations and joined by building ID, level and rank. It is not a functional building effect.
sourcePolicy.effectMapping: BenefitId for Original; BenefitIdD for D. Integer metrics are unchanged. Percent metrics are multiplied by 100 once during evidence preparation; registry values are already display percentages. Profile-specific metric definitions take precedence over building defaults.

applicability.choiceGuidance: Compare the displayed costs, base times and prerequisites with the game, then choose the matching requirement table.
applicability.distinctVariants: Labels A and B are presentation aliases only. Never merge, interpolate or substitute profiles, even where individual values happen to match.
applicability.levelScope: Publish only the explicitly retained level/rank rows. Higher configuration records do not establish available progression or account eligibility.
applicability.bonuses: Base values exclude research, heroes, alliance effects and other account bonuses.

units.resources: whole item counts in registry resource order
units.seconds: base seconds, stored without display rounding
units.requirements: target building level plus separate rank
units.constructionItems: whole item counts, separate from ordinary resources
units.battlePower: integer power points, not a functional effect or percentage
units.effectInteger: metric-specific integer counts or points; a per-hour metric is identified by its metric name
units.effectPercent: percentage points already scaled for display; do not multiply by 100 again

calculation.initialConstruction: Current level 0 includes the level-1 construction row. Current level 1 excludes it.
calculation.profile: Exactly one building ID and one profile per calculation.
calculation.rank: Keep rank in every source join. The current level-based calculator requires exactly one row for each selected target level and rejects ambiguous or missing levels.
calculation.resourceTotal: Sum each selected unrounded resource-vector component independently.
calculation.inventory: shortage[i] = max(0, totalResources[i] - held[i]); inventory is applied once after summing.
calculation.items: Sum construction item quantities by item ID independently of ordinary resources.
excluded: other account-specific speed or cost modifiers
calculation.invalid: Reject negative, fractional or unsafe inputs and unsafe sums; preserve the existing runtime behavior.
calculation.unknown: Do not total a selected row with unknown resources, time or construction items, or availability initial_conditions_unconfirmed. Never coerce unknown values to zero.

verification.numericBaseline: 1,520 existing profile rows reviewed; five null fields supplemented; two verified Enlistment Office construction rows added. Existing non-null values were preserved.
verification.privateEvidence: Detailed source record IDs, original old/new values and extraction proof are retained outside the public repository in the building-system audit ledger.

referenceTables.reason: The coal and effect-duration table has not been reconciled to an equivalent retained client field and unit. Preserve existing values, identify it briefly as a reference table and exclude it from construction totals.

displayPolicy.managementData: Build-only. Do not serialize governance, original source files, audit reasons, old guidance, hashes or extraction history into public HTML, JSON, structured data or metadata.
displayPolicy.publicProjection: Use an explicit field allowlist. Keep only values, names, navigation identifiers and essential calculation state needed by the user-facing table and calculator. The renderer configuration retains original availability states internally. HTML serialization removes every availability field, emits calculationBlocked: true only for initial_conditions_unconfirmed, and runtime initialization restores that guard before using the unchanged sumRange function.
displayPolicy.profiles: Retain original/d URL and calculation IDs. Display neutral requirement-table choices and concise game-matching guidance.
displayPolicy.unknownValues: Keep null and the calculation guard. Use a short unavailable value marker; do not repeat internal explanations or create empty sections.
displayPolicy.knownRanges: Keep the actual supported level range visible. Do not imply absent levels or uncertain account assignment are verified.
displayPolicy.effects: Display only reviewed functional metrics and their own units. Do not substitute battle power or another building's effect.
displayPolicy.priorGuidance: legacy-guidance-7a82e23b.json preserves previous internal explanations without exporting them to page payloads.

changeHistory.description: Baseline evidence records preserve five null-field corrections, separate Enlistment Office construction rows, building power and profile-specific effects. Exact changes are available in governance.corrections and the private ledger.
Move the existing model assembly into one build-only registry; archive prior internal guidance; preserve every model value and the cumulative calculation implementation.

errors.policy: Duplicate identities, conflicting power, non-null corrections, version mismatches and invalid public keys fail the registry build. Do not silently select a winner.
